ledger.claim: Whether the rider was at the pin is not a condition of this charge and must not be turned into one. POL-NS-06 makes a waiting-period shortfall refundable 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages', and none of POL-NS-01's four limbs reads rider position at all; rider presence enters the policy only in POL-NS-04(c), where it can exonerate a rider who messaged and never condemn one who did not. The rider track that the platform records roughly 519 m from the pin is therefore put out of account, and no adverse inference about the rider's whereabouts may be drawn from it.

The driver cannot stretch his hold past the single run his trace records. The only traffic advisory for this pickup, EV-ADVIS-09101-01, is MISSING and carries weight 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and POL-NS-06(i) is expressly unavailable on a MISSING or unpopulated traffic_advisory: none of KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT can be invoked to sum separate in-geofence intervals, and the driver cannot point to a second qualifying interval to add to the first. Chargeability of the SGD 4.00 fee must stand or fall on the one measured run alone.

Even taken at its highest, the driver's case clears the bar by twenty seconds. His qualifying run is 320 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum, and it is measured from the first in-geofence fix at 08:10:00 - twenty seconds before the driver's own 'arrived' event at 08:10:20, the event POL-NS-01(a) requires - so the hold that the record can tie to his own arrival marker is exactly at the threshold. On the ten-second sampling the trace actually carries, a margin of this width should be required to be established on admissible in-radius fixes rather than assumed, and any doubt on this limb is a doubt that defeats POL-NS-01(c).

No adverse finding may be built on the rider's lifetime no-show counter. POL-NS-09(d) reads rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, which is 0 for this rider, and POL-GEN-01 names only that trailing-30-day field as citable for the test while warning in terms that the lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags (1 here) is a near-synonym that may not be substituted for it. ledger.claim: If the effective in-geofence dwell is found to fall short of the 300-second minimum, or the arrival marker is found not to start the clock, the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee itemised in the fare breakdown is not chargeable under POL-NS-06, the full amount is refunded to the rider, and no driver compensation is payable on this record.

If, on the twenty-second margin and the discrepancy between the first qualifying fix at 08:10:00 and the 'arrived' event at 08:10:20, the Judge's confidence in the driver's arrival and dwell falls below the 0.70 platform floor, POL-NS-09(a) requires the case to be escalated to a human reviewer. An escalated fee is held rather than collected, so on that outcome the rider would not be carrying the disputed charge while the review is pending.

All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are satisfied on this record. (a) EV-TRIP-09101 contains a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-01T08:10:20+08:00. (b) EV-GPS-09101 places the driver inside the pickup geofence before that event: the trace's first fix is at 08:10:00 and every fix sits a mean 24.01 m from the pin, well inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius. (c) The driver held position for a continuous 320 seconds, above the 300 second STANDARD minimum, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix as limb (c) directs rather than from the arrival tap. (d) EV-TRIP-09101 records no boarding event and a driver termination with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW at 08:15:20, after the required dwell had elapsed. The cancellation fee is legitimately chargeable.

POL-NS-02's proximity test is met on the code-computed facts, not on assertion. EV-GPS-09101 carries 33 driver fixes for which min_distance_m, mean_distance_m and max_distance_m are all 24.01 m from the pickup pin, comfortably inside the 50 m arrival radius the fee_schedule fixes for the STANDARD zone class, and all 33 are counted as qualifying fixes after the 25 m accuracy filter. The trace is clean: coverage_pct 100, max_gap_sec 0.0 and no gaps. The driver was physically at the pickup point.

POL-NS-05 does not bite, so the arrival marker is not false. At the arrival timestamp the driver was 24.01 m from the pin, not more than 300 m, and the only distinct speed anywhere in the trace is 0.0 kph, so he was not travelling at or above 15 kph. Neither independent trigger of POL-NS-05 operates, and the waiting clock needs no recomputation.

POL-NS-06 does not engage, and no shortfall exists to excuse. The effective in-geofence dwell computed under POL-NS-02 is 320 seconds against a 300 second STANDARD minimum, a surplus of 20 seconds on the derived shortfall figure. Because the minimum was met without accumulation, limb (i) is never reached. Consistently with that, the driver does not rely on the traffic advisory limb: EV-ADVIS-09101-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0, and it is immaterial here precisely because no accumulation is claimed.

ledger.claim: POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, because two of its three limbs fail. Limb (a): not one message in EV-CHAT-09101 was sent by the rider. All three messages are the SYSTEM arrival notice at 08:10:21 and two DRIVER messages - 'I am at the sheltered pickup point beside Block 310' at 08:10:35 and 'Still waiting at the same pickup point' at 08:14:10. There is no locating or coordinating message from the rider to be left unanswered. Limb (c): the rider's track in EV-GPS-09101 holds 15 fixes of which 0 qualify (rider_qualifying_fix_count 0), at a mean 519.37 m from the pin - more than five times the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius. The rider was not at the pickup point.

POL-NS-03 is not engaged either. Its wrong-entrance doctrine reaches only a driver stationary OUTSIDE the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin; this driver was inside the 50 m radius, so the clause has no purchase. Its pin-ambiguity limb is likewise unavailable: limb (ii) requires trip_record.registered_pickup_points of 2 or more, and EV-TRIP-09101 records 1 for this pickup. The rider's 'I was downstairs' account is in any event contradicted by the rider's own device, which sat 519.37 m from the pin for the whole waiting window.

The charge is properly itemised and needs no correction. EV-FARE-09101 records a cancellation_fee of SGD 4.00, charged at 08:15:22 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. That figure reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule: the GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) is SGD 4.00, so no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect arises and the itemised amount stands.

POL-NS-07 entitles the driver to compensation of SGD 3.20, being 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee itemised in EV-FARE-09101, with the residual 20 percent retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip and compensation is therefore not withheld: EV-DPROF-09101 shows no_show_terminations_30d of 1 against a threshold of 4, and the clause requires BOTH limbs, absolute count and rate, so the second limb is never reached. Only the two fields POL-NS-07 names - no_show_terminations_30d and completed_trips_30d - are used for that check, as POL-GEN-01 requires. Under POL-GEN-03 the outcome the case produces is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd at SGD 3.20, while the rider's charge stands unchanged.

No escalation trigger is open on this record. The four POL-NS-01 limbs are carried by COMPLETE artifacts at weight 1.0, so the confidence floor under POL-GEN-02(2) is not breached and POL-NS-09(a) is not reached. There is no direct contradiction between admissible artifacts on arrival, dwell or rider presence: the trip record's 5.0 minute wait and the trace's 320 second dwell agree rather than conflict. Both counterparty-dispute counters are 0, so POL-NS-09(c) is not met, and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so POL-NS-09(d) is not met. The case is decidable now.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver: this is the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee on trip TRP-09101. The fee stands, and the driver is compensated SGD 3.20 out of it.

For the DRIVER: every limb of POL-NS-01 is carried by the record at full weight. (a) EV-TRIP-09101 contains a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-01T08:10:20. (b) EV-GPS-09101 places you inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius before that event - the trace opens at 08:10:00 and all 33 fixes sit a mean 24.01 m from the pin, so POL-NS-02's proximity test and its 25 m accuracy filter are both satisfied, with 100% coverage and no gaps. (c) The continuous hold is 320 seconds, measured as POL-NS-01(c) directs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 08:10:00 rather than from the arrival tap, against the 300-second STANDARD minimum. (d) EV-TRIP-09101 records no boarding and a driver termination with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW at 08:15:20, after the required dwell elapsed at 08:15:00. POL-NS-05 does not bite - at the arrival timestamp you were 24 m from the pin and stationary (only distinct speed 0.0 kph) - so the marker is not false and no false-arrival referral arises. POL-NS-03 is not engaged (you were inside the arrival radius, and registered_pickup_points is 1, not 2 or more), and POL-NS-06 is not engaged because there is no shortfall. You are therefore entitled under POL-NS-07 to 80% of the itemised fee, SGD 3.20. The anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against a threshold of 4, and that clause requires both limbs, so compensation is not withheld. Under POL-GEN-03 the outcome the case produces is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd at SGD 3.20; the rider's charge itself stands unchanged.

For the RIDER: your claim that you were downstairs and could not see the car does not reverse the charge. The policy does not make your presence a condition of it - POL-NS-06 makes a shortfall refundable 'whether or not the rider was present', and none of POL-NS-01's four limbs reads rider position - so your device's position about 519 m from the pin is put out of account and no adverse finding is built on it. The one route on which your position could have helped you, POL-NS-04, fails at its first limb regardless: the chat log (EV-CHAT-09101) contains no message from you at all, only the system arrival notice and two driver messages, so there was nothing for the driver to leave unanswered. Your argument that the 20-second dwell margin should be treated as doubtful and so defeat POL-NS-01(c) is rejected on the facts: the 320-second hold is not assumed, it is measured on 33 admissible in-radius fixes at 100% coverage against a 300-second minimum. The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-09101-01, status MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) is not relied on by anyone and changes nothing: it would only have permitted separate in-geofence intervals to be summed, and no accumulation is needed because the single hold already meets the minimum.

On the audit points: the charge is correctly itemised. EV-FARE-09101 shows a cancellation_fee of SGD 4.00, which reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule - the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) - so no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect arises, and no limb of POL-NS-08 (clock skew, trace gap, chat truncation or fare mismatch) is engaged. No profile field outside those the policy names was used against either party: the rider's lifetime no-show counter prior_no_show_flags was not employed, and POL-NS-09(c) and (d) are not met (both counterparty-dispute counters are 0; no_show_disputes_30d is 0). There is no direct contradiction between admissible artifacts on arrival, dwell or rider presence, and none of the POL-NS-09 triggers is open, so the case is decided now rather than escalated and the disputed amount is neither refunded nor held. Confidence is 0.90, set by the artifacts that carry the deciding facts, all of which sit at weight 1.0.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
